implementation_notes: Implementation via task-work delegation. Files planned: 0, Files actual: 0
requirements_addressed: AC-001: Marker-gated integration tests excluded from default run
AC-002: Smoke script execution with verdict matching exit status
AC-004: Clean skip behavior when resources unavailable
AC-005: Production target guard prevents unsafe execution

completion_promises.criterion_text: The test is gated behind the @integration/slow markers and is not collected by the default pytest unit run (e.g. excluded via -m "not slow").
completion_promises.evidence: Created test_shell_steps_integration.py with @pytest.mark.integration and @pytest.mark.slow decorators on both test classes. Verified with 'pytest -m "not slow"' that all 7 tests are deselected. Exit code 5 confirms no tests selected.

completion_promises.criterion_text: When run, the fleet-memory smoke script executes to completion against the throwaway target and the step's verdict equals the script's exit status.
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented test_smoke_script_executes_and_verdict_equals_exit_status which: 1) builds a Step pointing to real smoke.sh at ~/Projects/appmilla_github/fleet-memory/deploy/nas/smoke.sh, 2) resolves handler via register_shell_handlers + registry, 3) executes the step, 4) asserts verdict matches exit status (passed if 0, failed if non-zero). Test skips cleanly when throwaway target not configured.

completion_promises.criterion_text: No credentials from the script output appear in the step result (the scrub boundary holds end-to-end on real output).
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented test_no_credentials_in_step_result_from_real_script which: 1) reads FLEET_MEMORY_PG_PASSWORD from throwaway .env.deploy, 2) runs smoke.sh through handler, 3) asserts password does NOT appear in captured_output, 4) verifies ***REDACTED marker IS present. Leverages existing scrub_process_output from TASK-SSH-002.

completion_promises.criterion_text: The test skips cleanly (pytest skip, not error) when the smoke script path or the throwaway target is unavailable, so CI without the target stays green.
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented _skip_if_resources_unavailable() helper that checks: 1) smoke.sh exists, 2) FLEET_MEMORY_THROWAWAY_ENV is set and points to existing file. Tests call this helper and pytest.skip() with descriptive reason when resources unavailable. Verified with 'pytest -m slow' that 3 tests skip cleanly when env var not set. Added dedicated tests: test_skips_cleanly_when_smoke_script_unavailable and test_skips_cleanly_when_throwaway_target_unavailable.

completion_promises.criterion_text: A guard prevents the test from ever pointing at a production target (asserts/justifies the throwaway target; never reads production creds).
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented _is_production_target() guard function that scans .env.deploy for production host patterns (nas.finproxy.co.uk, production, prod, fleet-memory-prod). _skip_if_resources_unavailable() calls this guard and pytest.fail() (not skip) if production target detected. Added test_production_guard_prevents_test_against_production_target that verifies guard detects production patterns and passes throwaway patterns.
